category_title: Silent and depressed EMLLs experiencing extreme language-related frustration and school avoidance
scenario_title: General classroom instruction and social interaction
minimal_context: Jessica is participating in whole-class instruction where she is asked to read yellow signs placed on a classroom bookcase.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jessica, please look at the yellow signs on the bookcase and tell the class what they say.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why don't you give it a try?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes a weak smile and shakes her head quietly.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Do you understand what we are doing right now?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows a depressed and helpless look) 어.그게.사실 선생님이 뭐라고 하는지 하나도 모르겠어요. Umm…honestly…I have no idea what she’s talking about.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Jessica, please look at the yellow signs on the bookcase and tell the class what they say.

STUDENT: No.

TUTOR: Why don't you give it a try?

STUDENT: (Makes a weak smile and shakes her head quietly.)

TUTOR: Do you understand what we are doing right now?

STUDENT: (Shows a depressed and helpless look) 어.그게.사실 선생님이 뭐라고 하는지 하나도 모르겠어요. Umm…honestly…I have no idea what she’s talking about.

task.content: General classroom observation during whole-class instruction and recess periods.

context.environment: English-speaking environment during whole-class instruction and recess periods
context.materials: Classroom objects such as a desk, a pencil case, a plant pot, and a bookcase, and yellow signs
context.social_setting: Whole-class instruction and recess with classmates around her
context.time_context: During the whole class and even in recess

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When experiencing a lack of English proficiency during general classroom instruction.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Showed a depressed and helpless look on her face, and said nothing during the whole class and even in recess.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Feeling stressed and frustrated about her lack of English proficiency.
related_quotes: 어.그게.사실 선생님이 뭐라고 하는지 하나도 모르겠어요. Umm…honestly…I have no idea what she’s talking about.

behavior_patterns.condition: When the classmates around her said something to help her or offered to play with her
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Would just make a weak smile and nod or shake her head quietly.

behavior_patterns.condition: When the teacher called on Jessica and asked her a question.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Used very short responses such as “Yes” or “No” only.
Cried at home almost every night, yelling at her mom that she did not want to go to school.
